answer: Require every identity to lock a scarce deposit before voting, then slash it when an audit proves it endorsed fabricated work. Splitting influence across identities means locking more capital, and each fake risks a real loss. Independent reviewers can expose a fable of invented results; a public prism of audit records reveals coordinated votes, even along a ridge of agents. The attacker pays in tied-up funds and forfeited stake, not just the trivial cost of creating accounts.
